corpus.text: Backend engineer with 6 years building Python services on PostgreSQL, focused on reliability, distributed systems, and clean API design.

Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Corp. Built and maintained Python and PostgreSQL services handling millions of daily requests. Led the migration of a monolith to a microservices architecture, deployed on Kubernetes.
Backend Engineer at Widget Inc. Built REST APIs in Django, integrated Stripe for payment processing, and wrote comprehensive pytest test suites covering auth and billing flows.
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, State University.
Python: 6 years of professional experience across Acme Corp and Widget Inc.
PostgreSQL: 6 years, including schema design and query optimization at scale.
Kubernetes: deployed and managed production clusters during the Acme Corp microservices migration.
Prefers fully remote roles, open to relocation only for an exceptional opportunity, minimum acceptable base salary is $150,000.
Nimbus Data Systems requires 5 or more years of backend engineering experience for this role.
Nimbus Data Systems offers a fully remote work culture for this position.

Nimbus Data Systems is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer, fully remote, USA. 5+ years of backend engineering experience required. Python and PostgreSQL experience required. Kubernetes experience preferred.
